data.name: Haroun
data.gender_notes: Haroun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haroun is the name of Prophet Harun (Aaron) in Islamic tradition. He was a brother and advisor to Prophet Musa (Moses) and was appointed as his successor during his absence. This name is filled with spiritual significance and is a reminder of the importance of brotherhood, obedience, and leadership in Islam. The name Haroun carries the meaning “The Successor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haroun usually hope their child will grow to embody the successor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of brotherhood and obedience in Islam.
data.etymology: Haroun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Successor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haroun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
